Name: Brother May I Have Some Oats Pig Painting
Author: everlong504
Description:
The greatest stardew valley mod ever made. It replaces the Pig Painting you win in the Prize Machine with any of the 4 versions of the painting A Pair Of Pigs.

[img]https://file.garden/ZuHzAiORzGidu4hn/requirements.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]: I built version 1.1 of this mod based on version 2.3.0. It should be compatible with a few future versions. 

[img]https://file.garden/ZuHzAiORzGidu4hn/installation.png[/img]﻿
Install Content Patcher. Then extract the content of the downloaded zip file into the SMAPI mods folder and start the game via the SMAPI launcher or Steam if you have set the launch option for SMAPI in Steam. The config file will be generated inside the folder of the mod. Close the game to edit it and restart the game.

You can also optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change the config ingame without the need to close and restart (otherwise you need to restart) but it is not required to be installed.


[img]https://file.garden/ZuHzAiORzGidu4hn/updating.png[/img]﻿
Simply delete the prior version, install the new one and check the updated config created after the first startup (Changes require restart to take effect if you have not made them with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).

Most of the time, you can also just copy your old config file to the new version and it will work fine. Simply overwriting the old version generally also works (apart from keeping old unneeded assets on your hard drive), but is not a good habit because other mods, like CP mods, can have issues if you update them the same way.
